words.headline: Monday Warms Up: No-Heat Calls Drop to 676, Less Than Half Usual
words.blurb: A 70-degree high took the edge off the radiator gripes, with whole-building no-heat reports at 208 versus a typical 764. Overall the city logged 10,139 requests, about 2,500 fewer than a usual Monday.
words.card_line: Radiators off, windows open, grudges paused

boroughs.Bronx: Home repairs led with 604 requests, ahead of parking fights at 400.
boroughs.Brooklyn: Parking wars ruled the borough with 1,126 requests, the most of any mood anywhere.
boroughs.Manhattan: A close race: home repairs at 402 edged out noise at 388.
boroughs.Queens: Parking wars dominated with 904 requests, more than triple noise at 271.
boroughs.Staten Island: Parking led with 92 requests, while street fixes took second at 44.
